# The Aurora Hills — HDUDA Approved Villa Plots in Dharwad

> The Aurora Hills is an 18-acre luxury gated plotted community located at Sunset Viewpoint, Kelgeri, Dharwad, Karnataka. Developed by Sai Smruti Developers and marketed by Property Basket & ReachMax, it offers HDUDA and NA-KJP sanctioned residential villa plots with 20+ lifestyle amenities, completed physical infrastructure, and bank loan approvals from SBI, HDFC, and ICICI.

## Executive Summary & Quick Facts

- **Project Name:** The Aurora Hills (ದಿ ಅರೋರಾ ಹಿಲ್ಸ್)
- **Property Type:** Luxury Gated Residential Township & Plotted Community
- **Location:** Sunset Viewpoint, Kelgeri, Dharwad, Karnataka 580007, India
- **Coordinates:** 15.4589° N, 74.9902° E
- **Total Area:** 18+ Acres
- **Approvals & Sanctions:** HDUDA (Hubli-Dharwad Urban Development Authority) & NA-KJP Sanctioned
- **Title Status:** 100% Clear Marketable Title, RERA compliant, individual sub-registrar registration
- **Price Range:** Starting from ₹42 Lakhs onwards
- **Plot Dimensions:**
  - 30x40 (1,200 sq.ft) — Ideal for luxury modern 3BHK villas
  - 30x50 (1,500 sq.ft) — Premium 3-4 BHK duplex villas
  - 40x60 (2,400 sq.ft) — Signature estate mansions with private gardens
  - Custom odd & commercial plots also available
- **Bank Loan Partners:** Pre-approved by State Bank of India (SBI), HDFC Bank, ICICI Bank, IDFC First Bank (up to 75-80% loan availability)
- **Development Status (October 2026):** Fully developed physical infrastructure with completed 40ft & 30ft asphalt roads, paver pedestrian walkways, 1.5 Lakh Litre overhead water reservoir, underground electrical cabling, designer LED streetlights, landscaped medians, and grand security entrance arch.
- **Current Festive Offer (Dasara / Deepawali 2026):**
  - 30x40 Plot: Assured 1 KG 925 Hallmarked Silver on booking
  - 30x50 Plot: Assured 1.5 KG 925 Hallmarked Silver on booking
  - 40x60 Plot: Assured 50 Grams 22K Hallmarked Gold on booking
- **Contact:** +91 89701 98701 / info@theaurorahills.com
- **Official Website:** https://theaurorahills.com

## Strategic Location & Connectivity

- **Sunset Viewpoint & Kelgeri Lake:** Adjacent (0 km) — Uninterrupted panoramic hill and sunset vistas
- **Karnatak University Dharwad (KUD):** 5 minutes (3.2 km)
- **Dharwad Railway Station:** 10 minutes (6.5 km)
- **High-Speed BRTS Corridor:** 8 minutes (connecting Hubli and Dharwad)
- **IIT Dharwad Permanent Campus:** 15 minutes (12 km)
- **SDM Medical & Dental Hospital:** 12 minutes (9 km)
- **Hubli City & Commercial Hubs (Navanagar / Unkal):** 18–22 minutes via 6-lane NH-4 / NH-48
- **Hubli Airport (HBX):** 25 minutes (direct flights to Bengaluru, Mumbai, Delhi, Hyderabad)
